notes:
Account snapshot / CRM notes:
- Company: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app guidance). Heavy EU user base (DE/FR/UK).
- Primary ask: start on Hosted API for fast time-to-value, then move to Dedicated reserved capacity if latency, cost or residency require it. Typical evaluation path: hosted POC -> benchmark -> Dedicated sizing & contract.
- Use-case details: in-product chat (context windows ~2k tokens), semantic search/FAQ using embeddings for real-time retrieval, reranking top N results for UX. Target throughput ~40–80 req/s during peaks for their primary EU cluster.
- Latency requirements: product team wants avg <= 120ms for EU-hosted traffic (p95 ideally < 200ms). Support team acceptable with slightly higher tail.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller quantized open models for cost (7B–13B family) but willing to test higher-quality 34B for critical flows. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quant profiles).
- Regional/residency concerns (quote): "We can't have EU customer data leaving the EU for primary inference — fallback is okay for non-personal telemetry." Legal wants explicit DPA & data residency clause.
- Multi-region routing ask: EU-primary with NA fallback for overflow; want routing policy controls and clear latency/cost tradeoffs per region.
- POC specifics: SE to run latency & token-cost matrix across 3 model variants in eu-west and eu-central; provide KV cache prefix tests and a synthetic 5k-user workload.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, KMS for key separation, audit logs retained 12 months, retention controls.
- Cost sensitivity: product leads pushing for lower TCO vs self-hosting; finance wants line-item delta between hosted and Dedicated over 12 months.
- Quote from PM on 2026-02-03 call: "If we can hit EU p95 under 200ms with hosted and a clear path to pin to EU-only Dedicated, we can move fast. Pricing is a gating factor."
- Stubs / artifacts: see pricing deck + security answers above. Jira ticket REDWOOD-1128 opened for a clarifying question about cross-region KV cache consistency.
- Next immediate actions: deliver EU-region Dedicated pricing options and DPA language (legal); SE deep-dive on 2026-02-24 to finalize POC metrics and scripts; follow-up call w/ procurement week of 2026-03-01.
